answer: Require every agent to lock a time-staked bond that grows with each epoch it stays active: the bond is a public signal of commitment, and leaving early forfeits it. A sybil operator running an island of fake identities must fund a separate growing bond for each one, so the cost compounds with every copy. The network keeps a shared atlas of bond histories, so a fresh identity with no stake history earns nothing until its bond matures — patience becomes the price of trust.
